method: Second pass. Text, running order and kinds are unchanged from the first pass (faster-whisper large-v3-turbo, blind and lyric-biased, on the supplied vocal stem). Every start and end was then re-derived from the stem itself: 180-6000 Hz magnitude at 2.49 ms resolution, voiced regions by hysteresis, attacks by spectral flux. A cue was moved only where its start carried under 30% of the following phrase's peak AND a real attack (rise >=2.5x the preceding 120 ms, carrying >=25% of the next 2 s) sat within +1.5 s and at least 3x louder; cues are never moved earlier. Inside continuous vocoder passages there is no measurable attack, so those cues are held at their first-pass position and marked low. Ends are the release of the phrase body (smoothed envelope under 22% of its own peak for 150 ms), capped for readability and never running into the next cue.
clock: All times are the runtime MP3 clock. The stem is 0.051156 s ahead of it; measurements were shifted by +51.156 ms. Verified independently by cross-correlating the stem's vocal-band envelope against the MP3's centre channel: +0.050 s, matching the 2256-sample figure.
reference: Spot - Gateway (Mix 2026).txt (Suno lyric sheet; audio/stem is authoritative)
revisionNote: Seventh pass. Every cue has now been auditioned against the burn-in video. The 'Gateway' at 4:08 moved to bar 150 beat 1, where the stem's onset sits 2 ms off the downbeat. Ten cues confirmed by ear and upgraded to high; the two outro cues confirmed in position but held at med because they are not in the supplied vocal stem and nothing measurable sits under them. The 'Gateway' swell at 4:02-4:08 is an echo of the hook rather than a sung line and is deliberately left uncaptioned. 43 cues, no low.
